name: SynapLogic sale proxy unbounded referral rebates
summary: The SYP sale implementation paid a per-entry referral rebate without bounding aggregate rebates by the payment received. A bounded pre-remediation campaign depleted the proxy's native ETH and USDC inventory through the affected native and USDC purchase paths.
notes: The proxy was directly created with its EIP-1967 implementation slot selecting 0xc859ac8429fb4a5e24f24a7bed3fe3a8db4fb371. The slot and the selected 8,489-byte implementation runtime remain unchanged through the pre-incident state; all canonical proxy upgrades occur after the incident. Proxy deployment is therefore the latest age reset for the implicated implementation.

Gross loss is exact victim-proxy depletion across the bounded 22-transaction campaign. The native anchor sends 13.82328425 ETH into the proxy and pays 41.46985275 ETH from it, depleting 27.6465685 ETH; archive balance falls from exactly 27.6465685 ETH to zero. Nineteen later incident receipts send 1,770.548698 USDC into the proxy and 5,311.097380 USDC from it, for 3,540.548682 USDC receipt-net depletion. Two linked precursor transfers from a campaign EOA supply another 90 USDC and are excluded from victim loss. Archive balances reconcile exactly: 3,450.548686 opening + 90 precursor + 1,770.548698 receipt inflows - 5,311.097380 outflows = 0.000004 ending, so victim inventory depletion is 3,450.548682 USDC. The transaction set includes every proxy USDC outflow from the first linked receipt through the last cleanup receipt before the first post-incident upgrade. USDC is valued at par; the closest preceding DefiLlama ETH observation is $3,189.1171414638065 at 1768866603, 12 seconds before the anchor. Exact component values total $91,618.69418800332, replacing the seed's rounded $144,000 estimate.
